topWinningAds.headline: Your Mouth Is An Ecosystem 🌱
topWinningAds.caption: https://prodentim101.com
topWinningAds.body:
4 dentists told me "everything looks textbook clean."
2 ENTs checked my sinuses.
I even spent $2,200 out of pocket on a tonsil procedure.
Yet for 17 years, I couldn't have a close-up conversation without holding a hand over my mouth or popping mints every 15 minutes.
Here is the one simple truth that none of those expensive appointments explained:
Your mouth is an ecosystem, not a kitchen floor. 
When you constantly blast it with alcohol mouthwash and harsh chemicals, you eliminate the beneficial bacterial shield that naturally neutralizes odor and protects your enamel.
The real breakthrough came when I started repopulating my mouth with 3.5 billion targeted oral probiotic strains.
Instead of masking the problem, it addresses the bacterial imbalance directly. 
Week 2 was the first time in my adult life I could lean in and talk with total confidence.
